constraints: Skill metadata name: linear
Skill metadata description: Manage issues, projects & team workflows in Linear. Use when the user wants to read, create or updates tickets in Linear.
Skill metadata short-description: Manage Linear issues in Codex
Interface display_name: Linear
Interface short_description: Manage Linear issues in Codex
Interface icon_small: ./assets/linear-small.svg
Interface icon_large: ./assets/linear.png
Interface default_prompt: Use Linear context to triage or update relevant issues for this task, with clear next actions.
MCP dependency: linear (Linear MCP server), transport streamable_http, url https://mcp.linear.app/mcp.
Follow these steps in order. Do not skip steps.
Linear MCP server must be connected and accessible via OAuth.
Confirm access to the relevant Linear workspace, teams, and projects.
Step 0: Set up Linear MCP (if not already configured).
If any MCP call fails because Linear MCP is not connected, pause and set it up.
Step 1: Clarify the user's goal and scope (e.g., issue triage, sprint planning, documentation audit, workload balance). Confirm team/project, priority, labels, cycle, and due dates as needed.

Step 2: Select the appropriate workflow (see Practical Workflows below) and identify the Linear MCP tools you will need. Confirm required identifiers (issue ID, project ID, team key) before calling tools.

Step 3: Execute Linear MCP tool calls in logical batches: Read first (list/get/search) to build context. Create or update next (issues, projects, labels, comments) with all required fields. For bulk operations, explain grouping logic before applying changes.
Step 4: Summarize results, call out remaining gaps or blockers, and propose next actions (additional issues, label changes, assignments, or follow-up comments).
After successful login, the user will have to restart codex. You should finish your answer and tell them so when they try again they can continue with Step 1.

blocks.block_name: Check whether Linear MCP is already configured

constraints: Set up Linear MCP if not already configured.
Run `codex mcp add linear --url https://mcp.linear.app/mcp`.
If any MCP call fails because Linear MCP is not connected, pause and set it up.

Windows/WSL note: If you see connection errors on Windows, try configuring the Linear MCP to run via WSL: {"mcpServers": {"linear": {"command": "wsl", "args": ["npx", "-y", "mcp-remote", "https://mcp.linear.app/sse", "--transport", "sse-only"]}}}

blocks.block_name: Choose how to enable the remote MCP client

inputs.literal_value: set [features] rmcp_client = true in config.toml or run codex --enable rmcp_client

blocks.block_name: Clarify the user's goal and scope

constraints: Clarify the user's goal and scope (e.g., issue triage, sprint planning, documentation audit, workload balance).
Confirm team/project, priority, labels, cycle, and due dates as needed.

blocks.block_name: Select the Linear workflow and identify required MCP tools

literal_value.name: Sprint Planning
literal_value.description: Review open issues for a target team, pick top items by priority, and create a new cycle (e.g., "Q1 Performance Sprint") with assignments.

literal_value.name: Bug Triage
literal_value.description: List critical/high-priority bugs, rank by user impact, and move the top items to "In Progress."

literal_value.name: Documentation Audit
literal_value.description: Search documentation (e.g., API auth), then open labeled "documentation" issues for gaps or outdated sections with detailed fixes.

literal_value.name: Team Workload Balance
literal_value.description: Group active issues by assignee, flag anyone with high load, and suggest or apply redistributions.

literal_value.name: Release Planning
literal_value.description: Create a project (e.g., "v2.0 Release") with milestones (feature freeze, beta, docs, launch) and generate issues with estimates.

literal_value.name: Cross-Project Dependencies
literal_value.description: Find all "blocked" issues, identify blockers, and create linked issues if missing.

literal_value.name: Automated Status Updates
literal_value.description: Find your issues with stale updates and add status comments based on current state/blockers.

literal_value.name: Smart Labeling
literal_value.description: Analyze unlabeled issues, suggest/apply labels, and create missing label categories.

literal_value.name: Sprint Retrospectives
literal_value.description: Generate a report for the last completed cycle, note completed vs. pushed work, and open discussion issues for patterns.
